real_world.product: Clock movement with its motion works (dial train)
real_world.use: Pinions and wheels mesh in series inside the movement, stepping the speed down from the minute hand to the hour hand.
Two gear pairs share a middle shaft so their ratios multiply, filmed as a working physical build.
Helical gear pairs in a multi-stage reducer are shown being taken apart, with the slanted teeth meshing between shafts.
Helical gear stages are assembled on parallel shafts inside the housing to reduce motor speed.
The hand crank turns a large bevel gear that meshes with a small pinion on the chuck shaft, turning the rotation through a right angle and speeding it up.

real_world.product: Automotive differential ring and pinion set
real_world.use: The pinion sits below the ring gear centre, so the shafts cross without meeting and the pair is set up by hand-turning for tooth contact and preload.
Two horizontal pinions under the railcar engage a double toothed rack between the rails, so the car climbs a 48 percent grade without relying on wheel grip.

real_world.product: Gantry router on rack and pinion drive
real_world.use: Servo-driven pinions run along toothed racks and carry the gantry, so each turn of a pinion moves the machine a fixed distance.

real_world.product: Shimano Nexus 8 speed internal gear hub
real_world.use: Planetary gear sets inside the hub shell are locked or freed by clutches to give eight ratios, shown as the hub is taken apart.

real_world.product: Toyota Prius Synergy Drive hybrid transaxle
real_world.use: A planetary power split device joins the engine, generator and motor, so the engine power is divided between the wheels and the generator.

real_world.product: AAM 11.5 axle with Torsen and Eaton TruTrac anti-spin differentials
real_world.use: Gear sets inside the carrier let the two wheels turn at different speeds while still sharing torque, demonstrated on real axle hardware.

real_world.product: Helical limited slip (Torsen type) differential, Acura Integra Type R
real_world.use: Worm-like helical gears in the carrier couple the two axle shafts so a slipping wheel hands torque to the other, shown as the unit is opened up.

real_world.product: Ford F-150 Tremor front axle Torsen differential
real_world.use: A torque-sensing helical differential in the front axle is shown splitting drive between wheels on the real truck.
The unit is taken apart to show the elliptical wave generator flexing the thin flexspline against the circular spline.
A servo actuator is opened to show the strain wave gear stage that gives the 50:1 reduction at the output.

real_world.product: Vexta stepper with miniature harmonic drive
real_world.use: A small stepper-mounted harmonic drive is disassembled to show the flexspline, wave generator and ring.
